signal_of_week.headline: Simple-regret rates and minimax optimality of fixed-prior expected improvement in Mat\'ern and squared-exponential RKHSs

Nu in de gaten (nog onbevestigd): Ttft, Claude haiku, Autogpt.
NL-context: 33% van de Nederlandse bedrijven gebruikt AI (EU-gemiddeld 20%, bron CBS/Eurostat).
